title: Two flats
instructions: Nina iki daireyi karşılaştırıyor. Hangi bilginin hangi daireye ait olduğunu karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: nina
script.text: I'm looking for a new flat, and today I saw two.

script.speaker: nina
script.text: The first flat is in the city centre. It's near my office, so I can walk to work.

script.speaker: nina
script.text: It's small, with one bedroom, and it's on the fifth floor. There's no lift!

script.speaker: nina
script.text: The rent is nine hundred pounds a month.

script.speaker: nina
script.text: The second flat is bigger. It has two bedrooms and a garden.

script.speaker: nina
script.text: It's cheaper too, only seven hundred pounds, but it's far from my office.

script.speaker: nina
script.text: I need forty minutes by train.

script.speaker: nina
script.text: I don't have a car, and I hate trains in the morning.

script.speaker: nina
script.text: So I think I'm going to take the small one.

questions.prompt: Why is the first flat good for Nina?
questions.feedback: Birinci daire ofisine yakın (near my office), işe yürüyebilir. Ucuz ve bahçeli olan ikinci daire; asansör yok.
questions.evidence: It's near my office, so I can walk to work.

questions.prompt: What floor is the first flat on?
questions.feedback: Beşinci katta (fifth floor) ve asansör yok. "First" dairenin sırası, kat değil.

questions.prompt: How much is the second flat?
questions.feedback: İkinci daire yedi yüz pound (seven hundred). Dokuz yüz birinci dairenin kirası.

questions.prompt: How long does it take to go to work from the second flat?
questions.feedback: Trenle kırk dakika (forty minutes by train). Arabası yok, bu yüzden "by car" olamaz.
questions.evidence: I need forty minutes by train.

questions.prompt: Which flat is Nina going to take?
options: the small one in the city centre
questions.feedback: Küçük olanı (the small one) tutacak; o da şehir merkezindeki birinci daire.
questions.evidence: So I think I'm going to take the small one.
